content: coffee A controlled explosion on a film set near London’s O2 arena ignited a fire that destroyed a van and damaged a car and lorry. Firefighters were called to an open‑air yard on Dock Road in Silvertown shortly before eight p.m. on Saturday. The blaze was brought under control after just over an hour, with about twenty‑five crews on scene and no injuries reported. The incident followed a pre‑planned filming activity close to the venue, which will host concerts by Niall Horan and Texas the following week. The London Fire Brigade posted on X that the fire in the open‑air yard is now under control, noting that one vehicle was lost and most of a car and lorry suffered damage, with no injuries reported. They added that the fire stemmed from the controlled explosion that spread beyond expectations, and that crews would stay until evening. The yard is also near the Thames cable car link, and a Metropolitan Police spokesman said they are aware of reports of explosions heard near the O2 in Greenwich.
